Name: Adomin8ers Monster Party Packs
Author: Adomin8er
Description:
[size=4][b]DISCORD:
[/b][/size]Adomin8er's Modding Server → [url=https://discord.gg/7yhZF2XpP4]sdv-monster-party-packs[/url][size=4]

[b]Mod Purpose:
[/b][/size]To add in several bachelors and bachelorettes to the game with detailed character arcs.[size=4][b]
[/b][/size][size=4][b]
Use:
[/b][/size][list]
[*]Add this mod to the Stardew Valley/Mods folder on your system.
[*]This contains HD portraits for the additional characters. I recommend using my HD Portraits mod to match the aesthetic across mods.
[/list][size=3]ALPHA (VERSION 0.3.0 UPDATE):[/size]
[list]
[*]Adds in the female version of the Dhampir character to be unlocked.
[*]Adds in the female﻿ version of the Djinn character to be unlocked.
[*]Adds in the female﻿ version of the Kraken character to be unlocked.
[/list]
[size=4][b]Compatible Mods:
[/b][/size][list]
[*]Stardew Valley Expanded
[/list]
[size=4]﻿[b]Recommendation:[/b]
[/size]I built this mod to integrate with the game as seamlessly as possible. For the best experience, I would recommend playing this without spoilers and allowing the unlock conditions of each character to be encountered naturally. However, I want to give a heads up that unlocking each character WILL take time, regardless of whether or not you've played before. If you want to know the process of unlocking characters, see spoiler section #1. It will not ruin anything as per character details, but it will give you an idea of what it takes to unlock someone and why it might take extra time and be frustrating if you're just trying to see the new content. If you want the exact details on each character, then view spoiler section #2 to get insights into each character specifically.

[size=4][b]Spoiler Section #1 (Generic Unlock Process):
[/b][/size][spoiler]
There are 3 stages to each character unlock.
[list=1]
[*][b]Unlock the special order request [/b]- The special order board is unlocked in Fall of year 1. Each character has a special order request unique to it that is conditional for being put in the bucket of possible special order requests. This step can be manipulated by meeting the specified criteria for that character's special order request.
[*][b]Complete the special order request[/b] - Once the special order has been added to the pool of special orders, there is a CHANCE that it will show up on the town board each week. This is random and I have no intention of trying to change that. The best way to improve your odds of encountering the even is by completing as many special orders as you can. The quests WILL eventually show up.
[*][b]Introduction quest[/b] - Once the special order is complete, you will be given a hint on how to initiate the character's introduction. These hints are meant to be believable events in game so if they are a bit vague, they're still more than nothing.
[/list][/spoiler]
[b][u]
[/u][size=4]Spoiler Section #2 (Specific Character Details):
[/size]Dhampir[/b]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]﻿SPECIAL ORDER: Any player reaches house upgrade.
[*]INTRODUCTION: Visit Robin on Thursday.
[/list][/spoiler][b]
Djinn
[/b][spoiler]
[list]
[*]SPECIAL ORDER: Any player has both the crystal floor recipe and has visited Sandy's house.
[*]INTRODUCTION: Visit Sandy on Saturday or Sunday.
[/list][/spoiler][b]
Kraken[/b]
[spoiler]
[list]
[*]SPECIAL ORDER: Any player has the cookie recipe.
[*]INTRODUCTION: Visit the beach between 7:00 and 11:00 during a storm after you fix the small bridge.
[/list][list]
[/list][size=2][/spoiler][/size]

[size=4][b]Development notes:[/b]
[/size][size=2]I am making it so that the gender of each character can be swapped between male and female. This does not mean I am making two of each character. It takes me about 50+ hours per character so this is my middle ground of creating characters for multiple scenarios without burning myself out. Unfortunately, that means that the events for each gender will not be distinct.[/size]

[b]Disclaimer:[/b]
[list]
[*][size=2]Although the overworld sprites are done by hand, the images were created using Stable Diffusion along with the Divine Elegance model from CivitAi.[/size]
[/list]
